# Ayodeji Akintilo — Portfolio

> Brand Systems Leader, Creative Director, and Design Operator based in Berkeley, CA.

Ayodeji (Ayo) Akintilo has 15+ years of experience building visual identities, design systems, and campaigns for technology companies. He works at the intersection of brand strategy and execution — from IPO launches to flagship developer conferences, from visual identity systems to motion and experiential design.

## About

Ayo crafts brand systems and visual narratives for tech, SaaS, and cultural institutions. He works closely with C-suite leaders (CEO, CTO, CMO) to align creative work with business strategy, and embeds with product and engineering teams to build design infrastructure that scales.

**Contact:** ayo@akintilo.com
**Location:** Berkeley, CA
**Available for:** New projects, brand systems engagements, creative direction

## Selected Work

- [MongoDB IPO Launch](/technical-developer/mongodb-ipo.html) — Creative direction for MongoDB's NASDAQ IPO, 2017. Campaign ran in Times Square and San Francisco's financial district. Stock opened 34% above IPO price. OOH · TV · Digital · Print.
- [AppOmni Brand Systems](/brand-systems/appomni.html) — Visual identity, design system, and event creative for the SaaS security platform.
- [Secureframe Brand Systems](/brand-systems/secureframe.html) — Sole senior brand designer. Built visual systems and modular web components reducing page build time from 10 days to 3 days.
- [MongoDB World](/event-brand/mongodb-world.html) — Creative direction for MongoDB's flagship developer conference. Motion, environmental design, and speaker creative.
- [Navan (TripActions)](/event-brand/navan.html) — Campaign creative, event brand, and video production.
- [DocuSign Campaigns](/campaign-partner/docusign-campaigns.html) — Brand campaigns across OOH, digital, and integrated channels.
- [DocuSign Momentum](/event-brand/docusign-momentum.html) — Event brand for DocuSign's flagship annual conference.
- [Apollo Summit](/event-brand/apollo-summit.html) — Event brand identity and environmental design.
- [BetterUp Presentations](/presentation-design/betterup.html) — Executive presentation design for investor and sales contexts.
- [MongoDB Dream Big](/brand-character/mongodb-dream-big.html) — Internal rebrand reveal event; brand film and experiential design.
- [MongoDB Beliefs](/brand-character/mongodb-values.html) — Internal values campaign translating company beliefs into visual language.
- [Linx Security](/linx-security/linx.html) — Brand systems and visual identity for identity governance platform.
